(defmacro with-precision
  "Sets the precision and rounding mode to be used for BigDecimal operations.

  Usage: (with-precision 10 (/ 1M 3))
  or:    (with-precision 10 :rounding HALF_DOWN (/ 1M 3))

  The rounding mode is one of CEILING, FLOOR, HALF_UP, HALF_DOWN,
  HALF_EVEN, UP, DOWN and UNNECESSARY; it defaults to HALF_UP."
  {:added "1.0"}
  [precision & exprs]
    (let [[body rm] (if (= (first exprs) :rounding)
                      [(next (next exprs))
                       `((. java.math.RoundingMode ~(second exprs)))]
                      [exprs nil])]
      `(binding [*math-context* (java.math.MathContext. ~precision ~@rm)]
         ~@body)))
adaptation: Java MathContext and RoundingMode become immutable GC precision/mode fields; ordinary dynamic binding and body evaluation remain. All eight modes retained. Nil marks the one-argument constructor; explicit rounding uses checked numeric int coercion, preserving constructor overload behavior.
